Technology consulting built for small organizations.

FIDDLE,GREEN works with small businesses, nonprofits, startups, and public agencies, taking on the problems that quietly hold an organization back. We built the practice around work at this scale — so you get senior people, real attention, and an honest answer about what is worth doing.

Technical Support

  • Technology implementation
  • System configuration and optimization
  • Purchasing, procurement, and vendor advocacy

Training & Education

  • Training material development
  • Workforce development and capacity building
  • Training-of-trainers programs

Strategy & Operations

  • Technology-enabled operational support
  • Workflow automation
  • Vendor evaluation and independent second opinions

Artificial Intelligence

  • Safety and security strengthening
  • Policy and mission statement development

  • User testing and validation

Why FIDDLE,GREEN?

You are the destination, not a stepping stone. We are not building a portfolio on small clients so we can go chase bigger ones — this is the work we want, and it is why the attention is real.

We know how to make a dollar scream. Our team has worked in some of the lowest-resource settings in the world and with bootstrapped nonprofits running on fumes. We fight for you with vendors who ignore you, and we hand you the keys: documentation and training so your team can run it without us.

Whatever the size of the job, you get the same people and the same straight answers. The first conversation is free and commits you to nothing.
